findings.description: The cycle-detection guard (a `seen` set of visited exception ids) was removed from the `__cause__` chain walk. If the chain loops back on itself, `while exc is not None` never terminates.
findings.rationale: Trigger: an exception chain with a cycle, e.g. `a.__cause__ = b; b.__cause__ = a`, where no exception in the loop is an instance of `exception_cause_types`. The loop alternates between a and b forever, so the retry call hangs at 100% CPU instead of returning False.
